Summary: As an admin, I want to sign in securely
Description: Acceptance: correct credentials grant access; incorrect credentials are rejected; sign-out ends the session.

Summary: As an admin, I want to register products
Description: Acceptance: each product has a unique SKU, name, category, price, starting quantity and reorder threshold.

Summary: As an admin, I want to search and edit products
Description: Acceptance: search SKU or name; filter categories; edit product metadata; archive a product.

Summary: As an admin, I want to receive and issue stock
Description: Acceptance: IN adds stock and OUT subtracts it; negative stock is rejected; transaction is recorded.

Summary: As an admin, I want low-stock notifications
Description: Acceptance: items at/below threshold are flagged, including zero-stock products.

Summary: As an admin, I want inventory insights
Description: Acceptance: dashboard shows SKU count, units, stock value, category counts, alerts, recent movements.

Summary: As an admin, I want an exportable inventory report
Description: Acceptance: CSV export lists all active products with current stock and reorder thresholds.
